question: The Tiger Triumph defense exercise, held in April 2025, was a joint exercise between India and which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The US**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tiger Triumph** is a bilateral **Tri-Service** exercise involving the **Army**, **Navy**, and **Air Force** of both **India** and the **United States** (**US**). It serves as a platform to exchange best practices and improve **interoperability** between the two nations' armed forces.
 
• The primary objective of the **Tiger Triumph** exercise is to enhance cooperation in **Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR)** operations. It focuses on developing **Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)** to ensure a rapid and coordinated response to natural disasters in the **Indo-Pacific region**.
 
• The exercise is typically conducted on the **Eastern Seaboard** of **India**. The **2024** edition took place in **Visakhapatnam** and **Kakinada**, **Andhra Pradesh**, featuring amphibious operations and disaster response simulations.
 
• The inaugural edition of **Tiger Triumph** was held in **November 2019**. It marked a significant milestone
